title: Ending a Wayfare Driver Agreement, Reapplying and Fraud Payout Holds: Level Figures
content:
Three figures of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product concern the end of an agreement: when the driver's own closing takes effect, how long a driver waits to sign again after an agreement closed for cause, and whether a fraud deactivation holds earnings payouts.

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Driver's own closing takes effect | immediately | immediately | immediately | immediately | immediately | immediately |
| Months after a closing for cause before a new agreement may be signed | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Fraud deactivation places earnings payouts on hold | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

- **Reapplication wait** is counted in months from the date the earlier agreement closed for cause.
- **Payout hold on fraud**: on every level, a deactivation for fraud places the driver's earnings payouts on hold.

Hypothetical reading: under the 12-month figure, an agreement closed for cause in March 2026 keeps the driver from signing a new Wayfare agreement until March 2027.
